events.title: The Last Opening Demo Is Now Available!
events.summary: We are releasing it a little ahead of Steam Next Fest so you can already jump in and experience the beginning of the game.If you play it, we would love to hear your feedback: bug reports, suggestions, and general impressions are all welcome.The Last Opening will also be participating in Steam Next Fest starting October 19.

events.title: The Last Opening - Demo Release Update

events.title: The Last Opening
events.summary: From the developers of Svarog's Dream, we present you a new RPG: The Last Opening.In this title, you face Death.Each night, you sit across from him and play a move of chess. Each move brings you closer to the end.During the day, you survive the cold, gather what little you can, and make choices that shape the board itself. The world and the chess game are not separate.
